title: The restricted signed horizontal projection is epic
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every natural-indexed bicomplex has a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of bicomplexes of shape $\mathrm{up}(\mathbb N)$ in both directions, and put $M=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f)))$, with extension along $\mathbb N\hookrightarrow\mathbb Z$. Let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $M$ with $F.\mathrm{complexStep}(r,m)=\mathrm{coneHorizontalStep}(f,r,m)$ for all $r,m\in\mathbb Z$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients; lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable]. For $p\in\mathbb N$, $n\in\mathbb Z$, put $T=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(f.f(p)))[-p]$ and let $g:(F^pM)^n\to T^n$ be the filtration inclusion followed by the signed column projection [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection]. Then $g$ is an epimorphism.

proof.text: Construct the extended column inclusion as the extension isomorphism followed by coneHorizontalSummand when m>=p, and zero otherwise. The totalDesc inclusion equation proves that the horizontal projection retracts it; when m

Compose the two extended column inclusions with the source and target cone inclusions, including the required degree transports. Their images lie in the p-tail finite supremum. Apply the public Mathlib declarations Subobject.factors_of_le and imageSubobject_factors_comp_self directly to obtain factorization through the tail, without restating the private factors_image helper of ConeHorizontalStepStable. Multiply the source inclusion by (-1)^p and assemble the section with the column-cone biproduct decomposition. The source and target projection equations prove section followed by projection equals the identity because ((-1)^p)^2=1.

The assembled section factors through the p-tail using precomposition, integer scalar multiplication and addition of subobject factorizations. Use hF and imageSubobject_mono to factor it through the monic degreewise arrow of F.step p. This gives a SplitEpi of g, hence g is epic.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_projection_epi
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    Epi ((F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n)
